prompt: 同事問你：「我可以申請報銷這張計程車收據嗎？」你想說「可以，請在週五前交給會計」，哪句最合適？
options: Yes, you can be reimbursed. Please submit the receipt to Accounting by Friday.
Yes, you can reimburse. Please submit the receipt Accounting until Friday.
Yes, you are reimburse the receipt. Please give to Accounting at Friday.
Yes, reimbursed is possible. Please submitting receipt for Accounting by Friday.
answer: Yes, you can be reimbursed. Please submit the receipt to Accounting by Friday.

wrong.Yes, you can reimburse. Please submit th: reimburse 是「償還」別人，這裡是員工被償還，要用被動 be reimbursed；submit 後面缺 to，截止用 by 不用 until。
wrong.Yes, you are reimburse the receipt. Plea: are reimburse 文法不成立，at 不能用在星期前面，give 後也缺受詞。
wrong.Yes, reimbursed is possible. Please subm: Please 後面要接原形動詞 submit，不是 submitting，而且 receipt 前缺 the。

why: 報銷是公司還錢給員工，所以員工用被動 be reimbursed；by Friday 表示最晚到週五。
tip: 期限用 by（最晚到），持續到才用 until。
say: Please submit the receipt to Accounting by Friday.

prompt: TOEIC 填空：選出最適合的字。
text: The new software update ensures _____ with international data-protection rules.
options: compliance
complaint
compliment
complexity

wrong.complaint: complaint 是「抱怨」，不能與 with rules 搭配表示符合規範。
wrong.compliment: compliment 是「讚美」，與資料保護規定的語意不合。
wrong.complexity: complexity 是「複雜度」，句子需要的是「遵守規定」。

why: compliance with 是固定搭配，意思是「遵守（規範）」，常見於商業與法規文件。
tip: compliance with + 規定，表示遵守。
say: The update ensures compliance with international rules.

prompt: 這封通知的重點是什麼？
text: Please note that deliveries after 5 p.m. will be processed the next business day.
options: 下午五點後送達的貨，隔個工作日才處理
下午五點前的貨都不處理
貨物晚上會立即處理
只有週末才處理貨物
answer: 下午五點後送達的貨，隔個工作日才處理

wrong.下午五點前的貨都不處理: 句中說的是五點之後，不是五點之前。
wrong.貨物晚上會立即處理: 句子說下一個工作日才處理，不是當晚立即處理。
wrong.只有週末才處理貨物: business day 指的是平日工作日，與週末無關。

why: after 5 p.m. 加上 the next business day，表示過了五點的貨要到下一個工作日才處理。
tip: business day 指上班日，通常不含週末。
say: Deliveries after 5 p.m. will be processed the next business day.

prompt: 哪一句商務郵件的句子最正確？
options: We would appreciate it if you could confirm the order by noon.
We would appreciate if you can to confirm the order until noon.
We appreciate you for confirm the order at noon.
We would appreciate that you confirming the order by noon.
answer: We would appreciate it if you could confirm the order by noon.

wrong.We would appreciate if you can to confir: appreciate 後面要有 it，can 後面不能接 to，until 也不符合截止時間。
wrong.We appreciate you for confirm the order: for 後面不能接原形動詞，at noon 表示中午那一刻，不是截止時間。
wrong.We would appreciate that you confirming: that 後面要接完整子句，confirming 不能直接當謂語動詞。

why: would appreciate it if you could 是正式又禮貌的請託句型，by noon 表示最晚到中午。
tip: 客氣請託用 would appreciate it if you could。
say: We would appreciate it if you could confirm the order by noon.

prompt: 客戶問供應商：「這張發票的付款期限是什麼時候？」哪個回答最適合？
options: Payment is due within thirty days of the invoice date.
Payment is due for thirty days of the invoice date.
Payment due is thirty day from invoice date.
Payment are due in thirty days on the invoice date.
answer: Payment is due within thirty days of the invoice date.

wrong.Payment is due for thirty days of the in: for 表示持續多久，不能說明付款截止期限，應用 within。
wrong.Payment due is thirty day from invoice d: thirty 後面要用 days，invoice date 前也缺 the，語序不自然。
wrong.Payment are due in thirty days on the in: Payment 是不可數名詞，要搭配 is，on the invoice date 也不符合期限的意思。

why: within thirty days of 是商務文件常用的付款期限說法，表示在三十天內。
tip: 期限內完成用 within，不是 for。
say: Payment is due within thirty days of the invoice date.

prompt: TOEIC 填空：選出最合適的詞。
text: The marketing team will _____ the quarterly report at tomorrow's agenda review.
options: present
presently
presence
presents of

wrong.presently: presently 是副詞，will 後面需要動詞原形。
wrong.presence: presence 是名詞「出席、存在」，不能放在 will 後當動詞。
wrong.presents of: presents of 不是動詞片語，的確會讓句子文法錯誤。

why: will 後面要接原形動詞，present 當動詞表示「提出報告、簡報」。
tip: will 後面一定接原形動詞，不接名詞或副詞。
say: The marketing team will present the quarterly report.

text: Has the supplier confirmed that the packaging materials were delivered?
options: 詢問供應商是否已確認包材送達
要求供應商退回包材
宣布包材已經用完
邀請供應商參加會議
answer: 詢問供應商是否已確認包材送達

wrong.要求供應商退回包材: 句子沒有 return 或退貨的意思，只是在問確認。
wrong.宣布包材已經用完: 這是疑問句，不是宣布，也沒有 used up 的資訊。
wrong.邀請供應商參加會議: 句中沒有會議或邀請的線索。

why: Has ... confirmed 是現在完成式疑問句，詢問供應商是否已確認 delivered 的事。
tip: Has 開頭的完成式問句，是在問「到現在是否已經……」。
say: Has the supplier confirmed that the materials were delivered?

prompt: 哪一句的 revenue 用法正確？
options: The company's revenue rose by ten percent last year.
The company's revenues rose ten percent by last year.
The company revenue is rise ten percent last year.
The company's revenue rising of ten percent in last year.
answer: The company's revenue rose by ten percent last year.

wrong.The company's revenues rose ten percent: last year 前面不加 by，by 要放在百分比前表示幅度。
wrong.The company revenue is rise ten percent: is rise 文法錯誤，過去時間應該用過去式 rose。
wrong.The company's revenue rising of ten perc: rising 不能單獨當句子的動詞，last year 前也不加 in。

why: last year 是過去時間，用過去式 rose；rose by ten percent 表示增加了百分之十。
tip: rise 的過去式是 rose，by 後接增加的幅度。
say: The company's revenue rose by ten percent last year.

prompt: 主管問：「這次談判我們該先退讓價格嗎？」你想回答「我建議先談交貨條件」，哪句最得體？
options: I suggest we negotiate the delivery terms first.
I suggest we negotiating the delivery term first.
I suggest to negotiate first the delivery terms.
I suggested we negotiates the terms of delivery first.
answer: I suggest we negotiate the delivery terms first.

wrong.I suggest we negotiating the delivery te: suggest 後面的子句動詞要用原形 negotiate，不能用 -ing；term 也應為複數。
wrong.I suggest to negotiate first the deliver: suggest 後面不接 to 不定詞，first 的位置也不自然。
wrong.I suggested we negotiates the terms of d: we 後面動詞不能加 s，而且時態與現在提出建議的情境不合。

why: suggest 後面接 that 子句時，動詞用原形，所以是 suggest we negotiate。
tip: suggest 後面的子句，動詞用原形，不加 s。
say: I suggest we negotiate the delivery terms first.

prompt: TOEIC 填空：選出最合適的字。
text: Ms. Chen was hired as an _____ analyst, so she reviews our monthly spending.
options: financial
finance
finances
financially

wrong.finance: finance 是名詞，放在 analyst 前面要用形容詞 financial，才能修飾分析師的領域。
wrong.finances: finances 是複數名詞，前面又有 an，冠詞用法不合。
wrong.financially: financially 是副詞，不能直接修飾名詞 analyst。

why: 空格在冠詞與名詞之間，需要形容詞 financial 來修飾 analyst。
tip: 冠詞和名詞中間，通常填形容詞。
say: Ms. Chen was hired as a financial analyst.

prompt: 這段文字最可能在說什麼？
text: Text 1: The X400 costs $200 each. Text 2: Ms. Ho ordered three X400 units and received a 10% discount on the total.
options: 她應付 540 美元
她應付 600 美元
她應付 200 美元
她應付 660 美元

wrong.她應付 600 美元: 600 是三台原價的總和，還沒有扣掉百分之十的折扣。
wrong.她應付 200 美元: 200 只是一台的單價，Ms. Ho 買了三台。
wrong.她應付 660 美元: 660 把折扣當成加價了，但文中是 discount（折扣）。

why: 三台共 600 美元，打九折後是 540 美元；整合兩段資訊才能算出。
tip: 雙文本題要把兩段資訊合併計算，再選答案。
say: She pays five hundred and forty dollars.

prompt: 客戶說貨沒收到，你要禮貌道歉並說明「我們會馬上調查」，哪句最合適？
options: I apologize for the delay. We will look into it right away.
I apologize about the delay. We look into it right away.
Sorry, you delay. We are looking into it away.
I am apologizing delay. We will to look it into now.
answer: I apologize for the delay. We will look into it right away.

wrong.I apologize about the delay. We look int: apologize 後面接原因要用 for；而且承諾「會調查」要用 will，不是現在式。
wrong.Sorry, you delay. We are looking into it: you delay 語意變成責怪客戶，right away 也被拆錯成 away。
wrong.I am apologizing delay. We will to look: apologizing 缺少 for the，will 後面不能接 to，片語 look into it 順序也錯。

why: apologize for 搭配原因，will look into it right away 清楚承諾立即處理，語氣專業禮貌。
tip: 道歉用 apologize for，答應處理用 will look into。
say: I apologize for the delay. We will look into it right away.
